svg.aria-label: AI-integrated systems: transformer forward pass architecture from question to 5 autonomous outcomes
svg.desc: Visual walkthrough of a transformer forward pass: a business question types into prompt box, breaks into 9 tokens and embeddings, flows through multi-head self-attention and a 12-layer feed-forward block, and autoregressively generates 5 intelligent business capabilities.

g.text: Trained on your data, shaped to work.
